Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Old Bella Bella, about 57 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.06023, -127.48676, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 490 m NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 10 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2006 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-8, Region 5. Season: mule deer bucks Sept 10 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 44, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-07, closures 2026-10-16.
